caption: The drawing features a single lavender-colored ballet flat shoe with a closed toe, a low top, and long ribbons attached that are designed to wrap around the ankle. The shoe is depicted in a side profile and occupies the lower right portion of the image. The ribbons are loosely arranged around the shoe, with some extending outward onto the plain, cream-colored background. Above and to the left of the shoe, there are two simple line drawings: one showing the outline of the shoe's sole and the other showing a top-down view of the shoe with the ribbon untied. The majority of the composition is empty, with the objects centered in the lower half and left side of the image. The shoe's surface is rendered in a smooth, even tone of purple, while the outlines and ribbon shading use a darker hue. There are no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Slipper
